convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'ColorSchaffMomentumTrendCycle' custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all position open/close logic, money management, and new bar detection.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal time tagging
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime passed to position open functions

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator to be valid

other_exits: Buy close triggered when Color buffer[1]<2 (bearish color zone)
Sell close triggered when Color buffer[1]>5 (bullish color zone)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM input value interpretation depends on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses color index values from buffer 1 of the custom Schaff Momentum Trend Cycle indicator: Color[1]>5 means bullish color zone (potential buy entry when Color[0] transitions from non-bullish <6 to bullish), Color[1]<2 means bearish color zone (potential sell entry when Color[0] transitions from non-bearish >1 to bearish). Signal is evaluated on bar[1] vs bar[0] with SignalBar offset (default=1). Recount flag causes re-evaluation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose booleans gate which signal types are active. UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime are computed as last bar date + timeframe duration, passed to open position functions (likely used as trade window or expiry). GlobalVariableDel_ called on deinit for cleanup.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorSchaffMomentumTrendCycle custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it is a Schaff Trend Cycle variant applied to Momentum. The color buffer encodes zone state as integer indices (>5=bullish, <2=bearish). Entry logic depends on transition detection between color zones across consecutive bars. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_ - all must be reimplemented. The MMMode enum supports 5 different money management modes that must each be handled. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 pips are very large - verify if these are point-based (need digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers) or true pip values. Signal time tagging (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) likely controls trade window expiry in the open position functions.
